cases.name: accepted_a
cases.rationale: An explicit PDF/A-1a declaration satisfies the A conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: baseline_b
cases.rationale: A PDF/A-1b declaration fails the PDF/A-1a conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: missing_conformance
cases.rationale: A declaration without conformance fails the PDF/A-1a conformance identifier predicate.

cases.name: missing_identification
cases.rationale: Without PDF/A identification metadata, this conformance-value predicate is inapplicable; the identification rule is covered separately.

cases.name: tagged_valid
cases.rationale: MarkInfo/Marked true satisfies the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_missing
cases.rationale: Missing MarkInfo fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_false
cases.rationale: MarkInfo/Marked false fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_marked_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-boolean Marked value fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_mark_info_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-dictionary MarkInfo value fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_indirect_mark_info_wrong_type
cases.rationale: An indirect non-dictionary MarkInfo value fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_indirect_mark_info_null
cases.rationale: An indirect null MarkInfo value fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: tagged_indirect_mark_info
cases.rationale: Indirect dictionary MarkInfo with Marked true satisfies the predicate.

cases.name: tagged_indirect_marked
cases.rationale: Indirect boolean Marked true satisfies the predicate.

cases.name: tagged_struct_tree_only
cases.rationale: A StructTreeRoot without valid MarkInfo/Marked fails the tagged-document predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_missing
cases.rationale: Missing StructTreeRoot fails the structure-tree-root predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_direct_valid
cases.rationale: A direct valid StructTreeRoot satisfies the predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_minimal_valid
cases.rationale: A minimal valid StructTreeRoot satisfies the predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_indirect_valid
cases.rationale: An indirect valid StructTreeRoot satisfies the predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_invalid
cases.rationale: A non-dictionary StructTreeRoot fails the predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_indirect_invalid
cases.rationale: An indirect invalid StructTreeRoot fails the predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_unsupported_shape
cases.rationale: An unsupported but structurally valid shape does not fail the root-presence predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_parent_child
cases.rationale: A valid parent-child structure tree satisfies the root predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_minimal_valid
cases.rationale: With no non-standard structure type, the RoleMap mapping predicate is inapplicable.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_unmapped
cases.rationale: An unmapped non-standard structure type fails the RoleMap mapping predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_direct
cases.rationale: A direct mapping to a standard type satisfies the RoleMap predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_multi_step
cases.rationale: A valid multi-step mapping to a standard type satisfies the RoleMap predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-dictionary RoleMap fails the mapping predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_invalid_target
cases.rationale: A RoleMap target that is not a valid structure type fails the mapping predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_minimal_valid
cases.rationale: With no RoleMap cycle, the cycle predicate is inapplicable.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_self_cycle
cases.rationale: A self-referential RoleMap entry fails the cycle predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_two_node_cycle
cases.rationale: A two-node RoleMap cycle fails the cycle predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_long_cycle
cases.rationale: A longer RoleMap cycle fails the cycle predicate.

cases.name: struct_tree_role_map_acyclic_chain
cases.rationale: An acyclic RoleMap chain satisfies the cycle predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_valid
cases.rationale: A valid catalog language identifier satisfies the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_empty
cases.rationale: An empty catalog language is accepted by the pinned predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_invalid
cases.rationale: An invalid catalog language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_overlong
cases.rationale: An overlong catalog language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-string catalog language value is handled by the catalog-type predicate, not this syntax predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_null
cases.rationale: A null catalog language value is handled by the catalog-value predicate, not this syntax predicate.

cases.name: lang_catalog_indirect_invalid
cases.rationale: An indirect invalid catalog language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_structure_valid
cases.rationale: A valid structure language identifier satisfies the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_structure_indirect_invalid
cases.rationale: An indirect invalid structure language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_structure_invalid
cases.rationale: An invalid structure language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_structure_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-string structure language value is handled by the value-type predicate, not this syntax predicate.

cases.name: lang_property_valid
cases.rationale: A valid structure property language identifier satisfies the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_property_invalid
cases.rationale: An invalid structure property language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_property_indirect_invalid
cases.rationale: An indirect invalid structure property language identifier fails the language predicate.

cases.name: lang_property_wrong_type
cases.rationale: A non-string property language value is handled by the value-type predicate, not this syntax predicate.

cases.name: lang_property_null
cases.rationale: A null property language value is handled by the value predicate, not this syntax predicate.

cases.name: unicode_missing
cases.rationale: A missing ToUnicode mapping fails the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_scalar
cases.rationale: A scalar Unicode mapping fails the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_malformed
cases.rationale: A malformed ToUnicode mapping fails the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_incomplete
cases.rationale: An incomplete ToUnicode mapping fails the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_winansi
cases.rationale: A WinAnsi-encoded font with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_macroman
cases.rationale: A MacRoman-encoded font with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_macexpert
cases.rationale: A MacExpert-encoded font with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_indirect
cases.rationale: An indirect valid ToUnicode mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_type1_standard
cases.rationale: A Type 1 standard encoding with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_type1_symbol
cases.rationale: A Type 1 Symbol encoding with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

cases.name: unicode_type0_gb1
cases.rationale: A Type 0 GB1 font with a valid mapping satisfies the Unicode-mapping predicate.

upstream_failure_cases.name: struct_tree_cyclic
upstream_failure_cases.rationale: The recursive StructTreeRoot/P/K graph is bounded locally; veraPDF 1.30.2 aborts while traversing this upstream repro.

upstream_mismatch_cases.name: unicode_type0_identity_h
upstream_mismatch_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 reports a failure for Identity-H although the PDF/A-1 profile exception permits it.

upstream_mismatch_cases.name: unicode_type0_identity_v
upstream_mismatch_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 reports a failure for Identity-V although the PDF/A-1 profile exception permits it.
